why_concrete_objects_defensible.stable_denotation: fixed unambiguous dictionary meaning; judge not guessing denotation
why_concrete_objects_defensible.clear_object_function: objects have a graspable function giving an objective referent for 'fit'
why_concrete_objects_defensible.lower_emotional_projection: objects carry little affect; less feeling-match contamination
why_concrete_objects_defensible.lower_doctrinal_leakage: objects carry no doctrine; not convention recall
why_concrete_objects_defensible.easier_wrong_answer_controls: with a concrete function, mismatched modulations are more clearly wrong; sharper controls

remaining_risks.ordinary_object_semantics: LLM may prefer A_real via learned object semantics re-derivable from the anchor alone, not varṇa; mitigate with identical anchors across arms, tags may not restate denotation, semantics-only baseline check
remaining_risks.prose_preference: LLM may prefer better-reading option; mitigate with hard style-tell audit, shared register normalization, equal length/tag count
remaining_risks.scrambled_may_equal_real: prior automated scrambled~real (cosine 0.967); order may again carry nothing
remaining_risks.llm_object_fit_only: even a clean positive is LLM object-fit evidence, not human felt validation; ceiling is LLM_OBJECT_MODULATION_SIGNAL
